ambiguous.issue: Could mean the colour/shade dark or the absence of light in a room at night

ambiguous.issue: Could mean a lamp/light source or the adjective light (not heavy); also overlaps with lamp already on board
ambiguous.reason: lamp is already the preferred fringe word; light was excluded to avoid duplication and ambiguity

notes: Core emotional vocabulary (scared, cry, wait, hug) is especially important for this book as the story centres on separation anxiety at bedtime. 'Mama' is the child's primary communication target — llama calls for mama throughout. 'Red' was considered as a fringe word given the title, but the colour core button already covers colour labelling and the 11 slots are better used for narrative and emotional words. Existing activity_images already include llama, pajamas, bed, lamp, stairs, mama, dark — these can be reused directly.
